description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
